== Notes ==
* Consider using this with [[Plague Touch]] or [[Plague Sending]] for a second blind.
* Consider using with condition spreading skills such as [[Epidemic]] for spreading blind to [[mob]]s.
* The [[AI]] will only use this skill on a foe wielding a [[martial weapon]], regardless of it being [[Normal mode|Normal]] or [[Hard mode]]. This is similar to [[Eruption]], but unlike [[Blinding Flash]] and [[Throw Dirt]]. 
** The AI uses this skill on [[spirit]]s which are immune to all conditions except [[burning]]. <!-- Tested on Phantom (NPC) -->
